title: Appeal 18101 (reconsideration of 18056): roof and porch projections at a 40-inch fire separation distance (2018 IBC)

facts.text: Appeal item: OSSC 705.2 limits projections by distance from wall to fire separation line (24 inches plus 8 inches per foot over 3 feet); the request cites a 2018 IBC rule for a minimum 40-inch fire separation distance.
Reconsideration clarifies that roof overhangs in accordance with the 2018 IBC are also to be allowed.
Decision: roof projections with a minimum 40-inch fire separation distance from the property line per 2018 IBC are granted as proposed.
